title: Wave 1: shell and Connection screen, integrated
summary: Wave 1 of web/spec/README.md section 7 wired end to end against the ARGOS server (API 2, simulator, temporary config): the Connection screen (Instrument, Link with discovery as a cancellable job, the four-device table with per-device Connect / Disconnect / Retry / Cancel, Planetarium settings, filtered connection log), the start-up screen, status-bar device and network segments, the global Log drawer (L) fed by log v2 with replay, the rail footer (theme, Help) and the keyboard shortcuts sheet (?). Observe lost its Connection card (D10) and its theme button (D15). Checked by script: 57/57 UI checks plus 6 link-loss checks; discovery via a local fake Alpaca responder (no subnet sweep of the LAN), a closed port (127.0.0.1:9) and a black-hole address (192.0.2.1: Connect all fails in 3.1 s, longest frame gap 17 ms, GET /api/status at most 3 ms meanwhile). Night Red screenshots: 0 pixels that are neither black nor red-dominant.
